note: Mirror of TestEm3 run 0 (Geant4 11.4.3 examples/extended/electromagnetic/TestEm3): verification against the local example only, never validation.

source.geometry: TestEm3/src/DetectorConstruction.cc: 50 layers of 2.3 mm G4_Pb + 5.7 mm G4_lAr, fCalorSizeYZ 40 cm, layers along x; world = 1.2 x calorimeter (fWorldSizeX, fWorldSizeYZ), material Galactic (z 1, a 1.008 g/mole, universe_mean_density, kStateGas, 2.73 K, 3e-18 Pa); TestEm3 places the layers as a G4PVReplica, mirrored here with one G4PVPlacement per slab
source.gun: TestEm3/src/PrimaryGeneratorAction.cc: x = -0.499 x world x length, direction +x; TestEm3.in: e- 1 GeV
source.observable: Edep per absorber type excludes the world material (TestEm3 Run.cc)
source.physics: TestEm3.in: /testem/phys/addPhysics emstandard_opt0 (G4EmStandardPhysics) with G4DecayPhysics (TestEm3/src/PhysicsList.cc); /run/setCut default 1 mm (TestEm3.out cut table); /process/msc/Skin 1 is copied from TestEm3.in although inert under opt0 (Urban msc for e+- below 100 MeV uses its own step limit type)
